top_findings.title: No MCP server — plain query library, not the MCP protocol
top_findings.evidence: mcp_server.py has no import mcp/fastmcp, no @tool/@resource registration, no JSON-RPC or stdio transport, no async handlers. main() (mcp_server.py:652-688) only prints canned example queries; test_mcp_server.py:14 imports the class directly. The only mcp tokens are the class name BrazilianSoccerMCP (mcp_server.py:18) and the filename.
top_findings.suggestion: Wrap the query methods as MCP tools using an MCP SDK and expose a stdio/JSON-RPC entrypoint.
